name: Carrion Defense Works Personal Decontamination Kit PDK-3
product_name: Carrion Defense Works Personal Decontamination Kit PDK-3
description: A compact kit for field decontamination after chemical, biological, or radiological exposure. The PDK-3 contains reactive decontamination wipes that neutralize chemical agents on contact, antibiotic skin wash for biological exposure, a radiation chelation injector that binds radioactive particles for excretion, and a set of disposable coveralls for clothing replacement. The kit provides 15 minutes of treatment — enough to decontaminate a single person from most common CBRN threats if applied within the first 10 minutes of exposure.

specifications.treatment window: Most effective within 10 minutes of exposure

story_hooks: A PDK-3's chemical wipes failed to neutralize an unknown agent — the compound is not in Carrion's database and the decontamination protocol needs to be developed from scratch while the clock ticks.

PDK-3 kits have been distributed with expired chelation injectors that provide no radiation protection — whoever replaced the injectors wanted exposed individuals to believe they were safe when they were not.

physical_description.visual_profile: A ruggedized trauma-kit case with a medical-industrial aesthetic. Rectangular hard-shell container with rounded corners, designed for rapid field deployment. The case opens in a clamshell configuration revealing color-coded compartments and sealed pouches organized in a grid layout. Has the functional, no-nonsense appearance of emergency response equipment.
physical_description.dimensions: 28cm x 18cm x 8cm (briefcase-sized, slightly larger than a standard first aid kit)
physical_description.weight_description: 1.2 kg — handheld, can be carried in a tactical vest pouch or emergency pack. Light enough for one-handed grab-and-go
physical_description.primary_material: Reinforced polymer composite shell with pressure-sealed edges; interior lined with foam cutouts and biohazard-grade plastic separators
physical_description.finish: Textured matte finish for grip; UV-resistant coating. Faint radioactive trefoil and biohazard embossments visible under raking light
physical_description.color_scheme: High-visibility safety orange exterior with charcoal gray accents; interior white with color-coded pouches (green for chemical, red for biological, yellow for radiation)
physical_description.interface_elements: Dual latches with quick-release buttons; transparent sealed pouches allow contents verification without opening; laminated instruction card affixed to interior lid in multiple languages; small digital readout (battery-powered expiration date display) mounted top-left corner
distinctive_features: Holographic 'OPEN IN EMERGENCY' warning sticker with CARRION DEFENSE WORKS logo
Integrated wrist strap with carabiner attachment point
Three distinct treatment zones visually separated by internal dividers
Compact chelation injector housed in reinforced gel-pack chamber
Vacuum-sealed disposable coveralls compressed into accordion-fold pouch
QR code linking to decontamination protocol video on interior
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: CARRION DEFENSE WORKS stamped in black serif font across top; Φ2400 price marking faded from repeated handling; batch number and manufacturing date on rear; small regulatory certification stamps (GLMZ-approved, CBRN-rated)
physical_description.condition_typical: Cosmetic scuffs and wear from field deployment; latches show patina; instruction card edges curled; often found with medical tape reinforcing the latch seals; occasionally taped to vehicle dashboards or worn in outer tactical vest pouches
